name: trip-planner
description: AI-powered trip planner chat app: Angular frontend, Express backend, Google Gemini

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
